description: This Java class 'ProductImageCropUtils' provides functionality for cropping images, including determining if an image can be cropped based on its dimensions relative to specified sizes, calculating the crop area, and producing cropped images either as files or BufferedImage objects.

classes.name: ProductImageCropUtils
classes.description: Utility class for cropping product images based on specified dimensions, with logic to determine cropability and generate cropped images as BufferedImage or temporary files.

methods.name: ProductImageCropUtils
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with an image and its intended cropping dimensions, determining cropability and crop area.

methods.name: determineCropeable
methods.description: Determines if the image can be cropped based on its dimensions and the specified crop dimensions.

methods.name: determineCropArea
methods.description: Calculates the crop area dimensions based on the source image size and target size, adjusting if necessary.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a cropped version of the image as a File, given the top-left coordinates and size of the crop.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a BufferedImage that represents the cropped area of the original image.

methods.name: getCropAreaWidth
methods.description: Accessor for the crop area width.

methods.name: setCropAreaWidth
methods.description: Mutator for the crop area width.

methods.name: getCropAreaHeight
methods.description: Accessor for the crop area height.

methods.name: setCropAreaHeight
methods.description: Mutator for the crop area height.

methods.name: isCropeable
methods.description: Returns whether the image is cropable.
